node.statement: Definitional amplification bridge (no new algebraic hypothesis): in nodes 1 and 1.2, the notation (Ha^Q_{P,R})_n and the amplified column sesquilinear form mean the canonical matrix/direct-sum amplifications. Explicitly, for Z=(Z_ij) and X=(X_j), [(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X]_i := sum_{j=1}^n Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j), and for columns U=(U_i), V=(V_i), <U,V>_n := sum_{i=1}^n <U_i,V_i>. These are expansions of the two amplification symbols occurring in the contract, not consequences claimed from lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. In particular, replacing the latter formula by a nonunit scalar multiple would define a different form, not the amplified form denoted here.
